title: Checking The Age
description: Write a program that prompts the user to input their age and checks whether or not it is possible (at least 0 and at most 120). Only use a single if-command in your program.

paragraphs: Write a program that prompts the user to input their age and checks whether or not it is possible (at least 0 and at most 120). Only use a single if-command in your program.
